issues.description: Steel self-tapping screws in aluminium pilots risk stripped threads during assembly or repair; the screw set also lacks a specified count and drive type.
issues.fix: Specify the screw count and drive, validate the pilot against the selected screw supplier’s data, and use threaded inserts or machine screws where repeated opening is required.
issues.rule_citation: Pilot size and engagement must match the selected thread-forming screw and parent material — EJOT design guidance for screws in light-metal assemblies.

issues.description: The split-line step limit has no defined datum scheme or allowance for anodising and assembly variation across the two shells.
issues.fix: Define common datums, inspection points, and an assembled tolerance stack that includes finish thickness and locating-feature clearance.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional datums and account for process variation in tolerance stacks — ASME Y14.5; anodic coatings add thickness to aluminium surfaces — Aluminum Anodizers Council technical guidance.

issues.description: The shells have no specified locating features, leaving screws and adhesive to position the housing and control the split line.
issues.fix: Add a datum-based lip, pins, or equivalent locators; define which features position the shells before fastening.
issues.rule_citation: Provide positive location independent of fasteners for repeatable assembly — Boothroyd, Dewhurst and Knight, Product Design for Manufacture and Assembly.

issues.description: The battery pack has no defined retention, clearance from heat sources, or protection and service-removal requirements.
issues.fix: Specify the protected pack, restraint and removable adhesive scheme, thermal clearances, cable routing, and a battery safety validation plan.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The aluminium-and-glass enclosure has no defined RF-transparent antenna regions or antenna isolation scheme.
issues.fix: Reserve antenna windows or nonmetallic gaps, specify antenna placement and clearances, and validate performance with the final enclosure.
issues.rule_citation: Antenna placement and clearance must be validated in the final host enclosure — cellular module manufacturers’ antenna integration guides.

issues.description: The adhesive set does not define bond geometry, surface preparation, dispensing limits, or rework access for the display and housing.
issues.fix: Release adhesive drawings and a controlled bonding process with bead paths, cure conditions, inspection criteria, and a service-removal method.
issues.rule_citation: Adhesive joint strength depends on joint design, surface preparation, and controlled application — 3M structural adhesive design guide.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.00°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Bead-blasted anodised · Graphite #3A3D42') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 38.49 mm² (flat, 157.23 mm² at [-65.47, 0.0, 2.69]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 8298 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 42.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 60 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.3275 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 1.20-1.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

issues.description: Lead-free HASL is specified for an ODM smartphone board without confirming that its connectors and fine-pitch components accept the resulting pad flatness.
issues.fix: Confirm the ODM board finish against component requirements; specify ENIG or another suitable flat finish where required.
issues.rule_citation: Surface finish selection must meet component solderability and coplanarity requirements — IPC-4552 specification for ENIG finishes.

Sourced: 47 CFR 15.247 (Operation within the bands 902-928 MHz, 2400-2483.5 MHz, and 5725-5850 MHz): “(a) Operation under the provisions of this Section is limited to frequency hopping and digitally modulated intentional radiators that comply with the following provisions: (1) Frequency hopping systems shall have hopping channel…” — eCFR text as of 2026-09-22, retrieved 2026-09-26, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-47/section-15.247. See also 47 CFR 15.407, 47 CFR 15.19, 47 CFR 15.101, 47 CFR 15.109.
